items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: Well, not as much as Eddie, because Eddie was fortunate enough to make this European tour... But I have had quite a bit of success with most of the pupils I had at that time.

ctx.x: I was going to ask too about Eddie's South. Is he still playing around here?
Eddie... Eddie's not doing as well as he should with his talent. How's his health?
Did he have TB? You know, it's...
